brief.audience: Home bakers, culinary enthusiasts, working cooks and private teams seeking small-group, hands-on workshops in sourdough baking, laminated pastry, botanical fermentation and seasonal hearth cooking.
brief.primaryAction: Explore the four teaching disciplines and cohort schedule, then submit a workshop seat or private bench inquiry on the Contact page.
brief.content: Five-page culinary and fermentation workshop school website (Home, Workshops, Calendar, About, Contact) featuring an interactive four-discipline curriculum Tabs explorer with rich editable panels, a featured workshop Slider carousel using the reusable sorrel-workshop-card component, an unnumbered workshop day rhythm narrative, a 3-room studio Gallery with lightbox, top-aligned FAQ Accordions, two comparative curriculum and dated cohort Tables with direct action links below, four resident instructor portraits and biographies, ingredient provenance cards and a seven-field seat request Form.
brief.imagery: Eighteen distinct scene-specific photographs generated for Sorrel & Stone plus eight original vector SVG assets (dark and light outlined Fraunces wordmarks with stone-arch and sorrel-leaf mark and bp signature, standalone favicon, bp-mark and four semantic icons).
